name: qa-classes-gladiator-base-ranks
about: Full31-module controlled low/max base effects. Knives/Gladius use ordinary unique bound-button input with separate empty-field native trajectory and actual targetHP damage (noncrit fixture restored). Position Smoke/Net/Ward use explicit controlled native activation with center/outside controls and collider-aware low/max radius-discriminating point; Ward requires actual damage scaling. Pyre requires owned HP200/600, native repeated burns and8s unit lifetime with damage stopping after expiry. No exhaustive exact radius-boundary or normal cursor-targeting claim. Native reused Grappling Hook has only1rank and remains covered by baseline movement.
